items.en: leg
hurt, painful

Xiaoli: Let's take a rest.
Xiaogang: What's wrong?

items.zh: 小丽：我现在腿也疼，脚也疼。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ xiànzài tuǐ yě téng, jiǎo yě téng.
items.en: Xiaoli: Now my legs hurt and my feet hurt too.

items.zh: 小刚：好，那边树多，我们过去坐一下吧。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Hǎo, nàbian shù duō, wǒmen guòqu zuò yīxià ba.
items.en: Xiaogang: OK, there are lots of trees over there. Let's go over and sit for a bit.

items.zh: 小丽：上来的时候我怎么没觉得这么累？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Shànglai de shíhou wǒ zěnme méi juéde zhème lèi?
items.en: Xiaoli: How come I didn't feel this tired on the way up?

items.zh: 小刚：上山容易下山难，你不知道？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Shàng shān róngyì xià shān nán, nǐ bù zhīdào?
items.en: Xiaogang: Going up a mountain is easy, coming down is hard. Didn't you know?

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在打电话 — On the phone

items.en: Mrs., madam
secretary
manager
office
Zhou (surname)
Zhou Ming (name)

items.zh: 周太太：喂，你好，请问周明在吗？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Wèi, nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn Zhōu Míng zài ma?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Hello, may I ask if Zhou Ming is in?

items.zh: 秘书：周经理出去了，不在办公室。
items.py: Mìshū: Zhōu jīnglǐ chūqu le, bù zài bàngōngshì.
items.en: Secretary: Manager Zhou has gone out; he's not in the office.

items.zh: 周太太：他去哪儿了？什么时候回来？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Tā qù nǎr le? Shénme shíhou huílai?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Where did he go? When will he be back?

items.zh: 秘书：他出去办事了，下午回来。
items.py: Mìshū: Tā chūqu bàn shì le, xiàwǔ huílai.
items.en: Secretary: He went out on business; he'll be back in the afternoon.

items.zh: 周太太：回来了就让他给我打个电话。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Huílai le jiù ràng tā gěi wǒ dǎ ge diànhuà.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: As soon as he's back, have him give me a call.

items.zh: 秘书：好的，他到了办公室我就告诉他。
items.py: Mìshū: Hǎo de, tā dàole bàngōngshì wǒ jiù gàosu tā.
items.en: Secretary: All right, I'll tell him as soon as he gets to the office.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在楼门口送朋友 — Parting at the exit of the building

items.en: measure word for vehicles
building
to take, to fetch
measure word for things with a handle
umbrella

items.zh: 小刚：雨下得真大。你怎么回去？我送你吧。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Yǔ xià de zhēn dà. Nǐ zěnme huíqu? Wǒ sòng nǐ ba.
items.en: Xiaogang: It's really pouring. How are you getting back? Let me take you.

items.zh: 小丽：没事，我出去叫辆出租车就行了。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Méi shì, wǒ chūqu jiào liàng chūzūchē jiù xíng le.
items.en: Xiaoli: It's fine, I'll just go out and get a taxi.

items.zh: 小刚：那你等等，我上楼去给你拿把伞。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nà nǐ děngdeng, wǒ shàng lóu qù gěi nǐ ná bǎ sǎn.
items.en: Xiaogang: Then wait a moment, I'll go upstairs and get you an umbrella.

items.zh: 小丽：好的。我跟你一起上去吧。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Hǎo de. Wǒ gēn nǐ yīqǐ shàngqu ba.
items.en: Xiaoli: OK. I'll go up with you.

items.zh: 小刚：你在这儿等吧，我拿了伞就下来。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nǐ zài zhèr děng ba, wǒ nále sǎn jiù xiàlai.
items.en: Xiaogang: Wait here; I'll come down as soon as I've got the umbrella.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在家 — At home

items.en: fat
actually

items.zh: 周太太：你看，我这么胖，怎么办呢？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nǐ kàn, wǒ zhème pàng, zěnme bàn ne?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Look, I'm so fat. What should I do?

items.zh: 周明：你每天晚上吃了饭就睡觉，也不出去走走，能不胖吗？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Nǐ měi tiān wǎnshang chīle fàn jiù shuì jiào, yě bù chūqu zǒuzou, néng bù pàng ma?
items.en: Zhou Ming: Every evening you go to bed right after eating and never go out for a walk. How could you not be fat?

items.zh: 周太太：其实我每天都运动。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Qíshí wǒ měi tiān dōu yùndòng.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Actually I exercise every day.

items.zh: 周明：但是你一点儿也没瘦！你做什么运动了？
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Dànshì nǐ yīdiǎnr yě méi shòu! Nǐ zuò shénme yùndòng le?
items.en: Zhou Ming: But you haven't lost any weight at all! What exercise have you been doing?
Mrs. Zhou: Cooking!
